title: Breath-Ketone Trend During Fasts
dataSources: Continuous glucose (`cgm:glucose`), HRV (`hrv:reading`), mood check-ins (`mood:checkin`), ketone readings (`ketone:reading`), reaction-time trials (`reaction:trial`), sauna sessions (`sauna:session`), resting temperature (`temp:reading`), and meditation logs (`meditation:session`).
app: Biohacking telemetry from CGMs, HRV devices, ketone meters, mood and meditation journals, reaction-time apps, sauna logs, and health sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ketone:reading
| stats max(ppm) as peak_ppm avg(ppm) as avg_ppm by fast_id
| sort - peak_ppm
description: Summarises average and peak breath-ketone readings across fasting windows.
value: A trend view keeps fasting experiments grounded in data rather than hype by showing how the metabolic signal actually moved.
implementation: Log breath-ketone readings with a fast identifier from your fasting tracker or notebook.
visualization: Bar chart of average and peak ketones by fasting window.
grandmaExplanation: It logs how your ketone readings rise during each fast instead of relying on guesswork.
